subject.title: [BUG] memory index --force CLI writes incompatible meta providerKey, breaks runtime memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw repair shipped memory index providerKey/model/scope mismatches at runtime, through `openclaw doctor --fix`, or by keeping strict fail-closed behavior and requiring a user-initiated rebuild?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses persisted SQLite metadata, provider/auth identity, and runtime fail-closed policy; repository guidance treats fallback, migrations, and persisted state repair as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Doctor-owned repair
options.body: Add a doctor/fix migration for known-bad memory index metadata and keep runtime identity checks strict after migration.

options.title: Bounded runtime self-heal
options.body: Allow runtime to rewrite only narrowly recognized bad metadata after proving the provider, model, dimensions, and indexed vectors are compatible.

options.title: Manual rebuild only
options.body: Keep strict mismatch behavior and require users to rebuild or delete the index after provider identity fixes land.

recommendation.title: Doctor-owned repair
recommendation.body: Add a doctor/fix migration for known-bad memory index metadata and keep runtime identity checks strict after migration.
